# Modesto 1.0.0-alpha.1 — Release Candidate

**Classification: Release Candidate.** Semver `1.0.0-alpha.1`. First public build on the 1.0 line. Use it and review it. It is **not** a finished 1.0.

Local-first desktop for the coding agents you already pay for. **Chat** and **Work** in one workspace, plus Pull Requests, Agents, Tasks, Automations, Connections, and Skills & plugins. Modesto does not resell tokens.

## Chat and Work

Composer toggle **Chat / Work** (locked after first send):

- **Chat** — conversation-first. Start and send **without a project**. Sidebar section: **Chats**.
- **Work** — repo-scoped agent work: project, branch, worktree, diffs, terminal, commits, PRs.

Cowork tools beside the thread: **Connections**, **Music**, **Canvas**, **Artifacts**, **Browser**.

## What’s in this Release Candidate

**Threads** — New Chat, search, parallel sessions, provider/model picker, Supervised / Auto-accept / Auto / Full access, Plan/Build, mid-thread handoff, checkpoints, slash commands, Appshots, **Pop out chat**, header **usage clock**, inline diffs/approvals/Git, Mermaid/SVG/HTML previews.

**Sidebar** — **Pull Requests** (Reviewing / Authored; Summary, Timeline, Code) · **Agents** · **Tasks** (Draft / In Progress / Done) · **Automations** (schedules, webhooks) · **Connections** (Figma, Framer, Slack, Linear, GitHub, Adobe, MCP) · **Plugins** (Skills & plugins).

**Right panel** — Browser · Mobile Simulator · Terminal · Files · Changes · Music · Canvas · Artifacts · Context.

**Desktop** — local, WSL, SSH environments; floating music player; optional floating browser preview.

**Providers on by default** — Codex, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Grok, Meta (Muse Code), Kilo. Also: OpenCode, Factory Droid, Pi, GitHub Copilot (opt-in), Kimi/Qwen/Poolside/Devin (early access), Custom ACP, OpenAI-compatible routers.

## Known issues

- Work cowork is shipped; some flows (including Kanban drag-to-run) are still landing.
- Folder-free send is **Chat** mode. Work still wants a project.
- Reconnects and partial streams still being hardened.
- No iOS in this matrix. Signed GitHub Latest installers not published yet — `/releases/latest` is still the previous desktop until notarized/Authenticode builds land. Validation builds may be unsigned.

## Try it

`bun install` then `bun run modesto:dev` (Bun 1.3.9+, Node 24.13.1+, a provider CLI). License AGPL-3.0-only.
